# MCP Scope Consent Remote MCP

Paid remote MCP for MCP consent scope receipt, structured receipts, audit logs, and reviewer-ready evidence.

Website: https://mcpscopeconsent.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://mcpscopeconsent.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://mcpscopeconsent.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/mcp-scope-consent-mcp

Use case: MCP consent scope receipt with structured receipts.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: check_scope_consent, issue_consent_receipt, explain_scope_policy, log_tool_call, export_scope_audit
